name: Routes Traffic
description: A load balancer, DNS zone, route table or PrivateLink endpoint service routes traffic to a target (source -> target). A load balancer no longer routes here: an Application, Network or Gateway Load Balancer reaches its targets through its listeners, rules and target groups, and a Classic one through ROUTES_TO_TARGET to its registered instances (aws-core-tap#220); the load balancers' ROUTES_TRAFFIC rules remain, read empty, for one release so earlier edges are proposed for removal; a hosted zone to the load balancers and CloudFront distributions its alias records name; an endpoint service forwards its consumers' traffic to the Network or Gateway Load Balancer behind it. One edge per source and target. A route-table emitter, when one is written, routes by destination: it must declare its own identity discriminators (the destination CIDR) before it emits, as one edge per source and target would collapse its routes.

destination_cidr.description: Destination CIDR block for route table entries.

port.description: Target port for load balancer routing.
